facts.fact: Presidential Decree 25-320 of 30 December 2025, signed by President Tebboune and published in the Journal Officiel no. 87, sets up a national data governance framework (classification reference, data-source cataloguing reference, national interoperability system) for public institutions and bodies with a public-service task.
facts.system: Dispositif national de gouvernance des données

facts.fact: The decree names the High Commission for Digitalisation to draw up and update the two references and run the interoperability system, the national council for information systems security to rule on the framework's operation, the personal data protection authority to check compliance of cataloguing and classification, and the information systems security agency to set data security levels.
